verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical. Both stack the content top to bottom properly, but the circle and shoe sit low and crowd the bottom. 'Full review inside.' is jammed against the bottom of the circle and the canvas edge, while the gap below the headline is generous, so the vertical rhythm is uneven. A keeps the VOLTSTRIDE logo closer to the original's proportion, but it comes uncomfortably close to the NEW VIDEO badge. B leaves more room there by shrinking the logo, which makes the brand mark weak and small at this size.
